answer: Replay-audit rings. Each epoch, agents' transcripts are hashed onto a public island of records. Next epoch, each agent is assigned three random peers and re-runs one anchored task per peer, checking hashes against the grove of record. A fake's invented transcript fails replay: its inputs no longer match the signal. One replayable fake transcript costs ~15 GPU-hours, so 1,000 fakes need 15,000 GPU-hours per epoch. Honest agents pay almost nothing: their work already exists, and three replays take 90 minutes. One failed replay freezes identity and rewards for three epochs.
